metadata.description: Deployment location for newly created resources. Must match the App Service Plan region.
Globally unique Azure App Service Web App name.
Python runtime version on App Service Linux.
App Service Plan SKU when provisioning a new Linux plan.
Enable AlwaysOn on the Linux Web App (disable only for Free/Shared test plans).
Optional resource ID of an existing Linux App Service Plan. Empty creates a new plan.
Optional resource ID of an existing Storage Account. Empty creates a new OAuth-only Storage Account.
Optional resource ID of an existing Key Vault. Empty creates a new RBAC Key Vault with purge protection.
Optional resource ID of an existing Log Analytics Workspace for App Service Diagnostic Settings.
Skip creating diag-<webAppName> when another diagnostic setting on the Web App (e.g. Azure Policy DeployIfNotExists) already streams to existingLogAnalyticsWorkspaceId.
Optional explicit Storage namespace prefix for isolating this app on a shared Storage Account.
Optional explicit Blob container name override (3-63 lowercase chars, no double hyphens). Defaults to <namespace>-backups.
Blob path prefix inside the container.
Display name of the workspace shown in the console header.
Target Azure subscription ID whose resources are discovered and backed up. Defaults to the current deployment subscription.
Display name of the target subscription shown in the console.
Enable live ARM restore and clone execution in the console.
Number of days (1..7) of Azure Activity Log change attribution to query.
Inbound public network access on App Service and SCM/Kudu. Defaults to Disabled for KT Azure Policy compliance.

Optional allowed client IPv4 addresses or CIDRs when webAppPublicNetworkAccess is Enabled. Sets ipSecurityRestrictionsDefaultAction=Deny on both main site and SCM to satisfy KT Policy 1ecd1aa5e35f50d5ab9c6d0d.
True when deploying an Oryx source ZIP (SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT=true); false when deploying pre-bundled Linux wheels.
Optional name for the dedicated User Assigned Managed Identity created in the project Resource Group when existingManagedIdentityId is empty (defaults to id-<slug>).
Optional resource ID of an existing User Assigned Managed Identity to attach to the Web App and use for all ARM, Storage, and Monitor API calls. System Assigned Managed Identity is always disabled.
Optional additional User Assigned Managed Identity resource IDs already attached to the Web App to preserve on idempotent re-runs.
Optional pre-resolved Client ID (UUID) of existingManagedIdentityId.
Optional pre-resolved Principal/Object ID (UUID) of existingManagedIdentityId.
Sign-in provider: password (direct scrypt hash in App Settings by default while Entra ID is pending).
Use Azure Key Vault secret reference (@Microsoft.KeyVault) for admin password. Defaults to false so temporary ID/Password sign-in works directly via App Settings without Key Vault secrets or RBAC.
Built-in sign-in username when authProvider is password.
Salted scrypt password verifier hash (scrypt:N:r:p:salt:digest) set in ARMBACKUP_AUTH_PASSWORD_HASH when useKeyVaultSecret is false and adminPassword is empty.
Optional sign-in password override (stored in Key Vault only when useKeyVaultSecret is true, otherwise passed via ARMBACKUP_ADMIN_PASSWORD when explicitly provided).
Optional Log Analytics Workspace GUID (customerId) for custom ArmBackup_CL DCR/DCE event querying (fail-open).
Optional Data Collection Rule ARM resource ID for custom ArmBackup_CL ingestion (fail-open).
Optional Data Collection Rule immutableId (dcr-...) for custom ArmBackup_CL ingestion (fail-open).
Optional DCE/DCR logs ingestion endpoint URL (https://...ingest.monitor.azure.com) for custom ArmBackup_CL ingestion (fail-open).
Optional DCR stream name (e.g. Custom-ArmBackup_CL or Custom-ArmBackup).
Optional VNet subnet resource ID for regional VNet integration (required when Storage or Key Vault is private).

Route all outbound internet traffic through VNet integration. Defaults to false so RFC1918 Private Endpoints and VNet/Hub routes traverse VNet integration while Azure Resource Manager and Entra ID remain reachable even on defaultOutboundAccess=false subnets without NAT Gateway.
Optional existing subnet resource ID for Private Endpoints (App Service inbound sites PE and/or missing shared Storage/KeyVault PEs).
Optional Resource Group name where Private Endpoints are placed (defaults to current deployment Resource Group).
Create inbound Private Endpoint (groupIds: [sites]) for the Web App when a Private Endpoint subnet is available.
Subset of Storage sub-resources (blob) for which a missing Private Endpoint should be created on privateEndpointSubnetId.
Create a vault Private Endpoint on privateEndpointSubnetId for an existing shared Key Vault that lacks one.
Optional existing Private DNS Zone resource IDs. Leave empty in KT subscriptions where central Hub DNS / Azure Policy DINE manages privatelink.* zones.
Provision a dedicated VNet, App Service subnet, and Private Endpoints + Private DNS Zones when vnetIntegrationSubnetId is empty.
CIDR block for the managed VNet when enablePrivateNetworking creates one.
App Service regional VNet integration subnet CIDR inside vnetAddressPrefix.
Private Endpoint subnet CIDR inside vnetAddressPrefix.
Whether to create Storage/Key Vault data-plane RBAC assignments inside this deployment. Defaults to false so Contributor operators can deploy without Role Assignment permissions.

Provision Blob container via ARM during deployment. Defaults to false when using a shared Storage Account without RBAC assignment because the Python runtime auto-creates the container via Managed Identity.
Scope Storage/Key Vault RBAC strictly to this app container/secret (true) vs whole account/vault (false).
